deities: Lord Shiva as Pashupatinath (named for Pashupatinath of Kathmandu; the murti/architecture of this shrine is unsourced)

history.summary: IDENTITY: verified as entry #41 'Namchi pasupathinath Mandir', location Namchi, on the Sikkim Ecclesiastical Department's official district-wise list of Hindu mandirs - it is a real Shiva shrine in Namchi town, distinct from the Dambu Dara Pasupathinath Mandir (South #10, location Dambu Dara). No independent web source (place listings, directories, news) mentions it, so its architecture, age and management are undocumented. The name indicates it is inspired by Kathmandu's Pashupatinath (a major pilgrimage link for the Nepali-Hindu community of Sikkim); whether it is a deliberate replica or simply a namesake is unverified. Coordinates are a Namchi-town fallback only - approximate, flagged.

name: Namchi Pashupatinath Mandir
town_description: Namchi is the headquarters of Namchi district (South Sikkim), about 78 km from Gangtok, and a major religious-tourism hub of the state with the Char Dham, Samdruptse (Guru Padmasambhava statue) and the Sai Mandir.

travel.airport: Bagdogra Airport, West Bengal, about 102 km from Namchi (per namchi.nic.in); Pakyong Airport near Gangtok is closer by air distance (verify).
travel.railway: New Jalpaiguri (NJP) Station, West Bengal, about 96 km from Namchi.
travel.road: About 92 km from Siliguri; SNT buses and shared/private taxis run regularly from Namchi town.

visitor_information.best_time: March to May and October to December for clear mountain views of Kanchenjunga and the valleys.
